long_biography.plain_text:
World Exclusive Realty gave Alexander Burtakov a formal operating role in Monaco's property-services sector. As an associate and co-manager, he oversaw a company established to negotiate and broker overseas property contracts. He later represented the acquiring partnership when the business transferred its assets and dissolved.

In Britain, Burtakov served as both director and secretary of Burtakov Consultants, a London management consultancy. The company operated under his name before becoming London and Southeast Consultancy. It filed dormant accounts during its early years and later dissolved, closing a corporate appointment he had held since its incorporation.
